issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按「单次推入 30f」只渲出第一推的前半截，三连推根本没演出来
三章底色是死平的纯色块，没有受光与层次，像 PPT 色板
窗口卡标题栏是 2px 灰边 + 灰色骨架条，交通灯偏大，章内装饰只是几根白色半透明胶囊条
推入初速约 270px/帧却完全没有运动模糊，快进段读作跳帧
卡片阴影是统一黑色 rgba，压在饱和底色上发脏
changes: 补 BOTTOM_PUSH_STACK_WIPE_DURATION = 140（md 写明的三连推全长），推入曲线/起推帧 18/55/92 与 30f 时长保持不变
每章底色改为同色相上亮下沉的 172° 渐变 + 左上柔光斑 + 章色暗角 + 颗粒；第 0 章用中性 Backdrop
窗口卡：发丝线外框 + 顶部内高光 + 按章色调的两层软阴影（elevation 36），标题栏渐变底、13px 交通灯、居中窗口标题，内容换成 Phase 0 出版级 Card
白色装饰条升级为章节号胶囊 + 46px 章名、受光玻璃圆、右下三格页码（当前章点亮），换章即节拍器
整摞按推入速度做纵向 SpeedBlur（两章刚性同速，一层模糊管两章，封顶 22px，hold 段为 0）；接缝阴影改两段式近实远虚 + 新章上缘 2px 受光边
issuesEn: No exported duration constant, so the workbench rendered only 30f — half of the first push; the triple push never played
Chapter backgrounds were dead-flat solid fills with no light or depth, like a slide swatch
Window title bar used a 2px grey border and skeleton bars, oversized traffic lights; chapter decorations were just a few translucent pills
Initial push speed is ~270px/frame yet there was no motion blur, so the fast phase read as dropped frames
Card shadows were a uniform black rgba that looked dirty on saturated backgrounds
changesEn: Added BOTTOM_PUSH_STACK_WIPE_DURATION = 140 (the full triple push from the md); push curve, start frames 18/55/92 and 30f duration unchanged
Each chapter colour is now a same-hue 172° gradient (lighter top, deeper bottom) with a top-left soft light, hue-tinted vignette and grain; chapter 0 uses the neutral Backdrop

Window card: hairline frame, top inner highlight, two-layer soft shadow tinted by the chapter hue (elevation 36), gradient title bar with 13px traffic lights and a centred title, body replaced by the publication-grade Card
Decorative pills became a chapter-number capsule + 46px chapter title, a lit glass orb and a three-segment pager that lights the current chapter

The whole stack gets vertical SpeedBlur driven by push velocity (both chapters move rigidly, so one blur layer covers both; capped at 22px, zero during holds); seam shadow is two-stage near-sharp/far-soft plus a 2px lit top edge on the incoming chapter
